description: DirectJob Scout dependency-automation config. Renovate watches
requirements.txt and requirements-dev.txt for outdated pins and
opens PRs when updates are available.
Activation: install the Renovate GitHub App on the repository.
This config file is the contract between the project and the app;
without the app installed nothing happens.
Groupings: minor and patch updates of dev tooling and runtime
dependencies are grouped weekly. Major releases get their own PRs
with explicit reviewer attention. Security updates land
Auto-merge is enabled for minor + patch updates of linters
(ruff, codespell, mypy) and test tools (coverage, pip-audit) —
these are low-risk and unblock CI without manual review.

packageRules.description: Group dev-tooling minor/patch updates into a single weekly PR.
Group runtime minor/patch updates into a single weekly PR.
cryptography major releases get explicit reviewer attention because the encryption-at-rest format and the AI-Act audit-log salt hashing depend on this dependency.
Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs to satisfy OpenSSF Scorecard.
